comments.content: REDIS_PORT is being set to configs.MetricsPort which is the metrics server port, not a Redis port. The test previously used a fixed mock port "2001". Using the metrics port is semantically wrong and can cause confusion / port collisions. Use a dedicated free port or keep the mock value.

TestContext_WriteMessageToSocket now starts app.Run() in a goroutine and immediately dials ws://localhost:configs.HTTPPort/ws without waiting for the server to be listening. The previous implementation used httptest.NewServer which is ready synchronously. Add a small sleep / readiness check before Dial to avoid flaky race, or keep the httptest server approach.
